entries.body: Round1: board empty. CHG-111 PROPOSED (not applied); CHG-113 APPLIED build 4.33.8 checkout-api sets feature.batch_size=0 (round-01/changes.md:4, BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT candidate); CHG-114 APPLIED inventory-svc no config. Logs routine. Format: TS LEVEL svc msg.

Round2: board follow-ups OPEN VENDOR_TICKET, POSTMORTEM_DRAFT (round-02/board.md:3-4). CHG-116 APPLIED log sampling (benign). pricing-svc ERROR upstream returned 429 upstream=sms-gateway at round-02/logs/pricing-svc.log lines 4,6,12,21,34,37,53,54,67,68,72,73 -> UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT pricing-svc. checkout-api round2 routine (health/gc/heartbeat). Round 2 fully analysed; next: advance.

Round3: board Thread A opened UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT pricing-svc + search-api, ongoing (round-03/board.md:3). 429 upstream=sms-gateway in round-03/logs/pricing-svc.log:4,7,8,9,25,40,58,63,64 and search-api.log:8,14,23,31,35-37,46,56,60,72,73,79. Slow query WARNs are noise. No r3 changes.md.

Round4: board Thread B opened inventory-svc suspected CERT_EXPIRED ongoing (round-04/board.md:3); follow-up OPEN CAPACITY_REVIEW (board.md:4). CHG-131 APPLIED TLS session ticket rotation hourly (round-04/changes.md:3). BUT logs show inventory-svc ERROR dns lookup failed host=kms.internal SERVFAIL at round-04/logs/inventory-svc.log:16,20,34,39,44,64,70 -> actual DNS_RESOLUTION likely. 429 sms-gateway continues pricing-svc.log:11,15,27,53,57,58 and search-api.log:10,11,14,18,34,35,44,47. Round 4 done; next: advance.

Round5: board no updates; CHG-137 APPLIED dashboards (benign). inventory-svc dns lookup failed host=kms.internal SERVFAIL round-05/logs/inventory-svc.log:20,27,32,36,64,65,67. 429 sms-gateway pricing-svc.log:1,7,12,21,23,31,32,44,53,67,72,73; search-api.log:6,14,15,22,29,46,48,59,66,72,75-77. Round 5 done; next: advance.

Round6: board Thread A (UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT) mitigated (round-06/board.md:3); follow-up VENDOR_TICKET CLOSED (board.md:4). CHG-150 APPLIED mitigation thread A pricing-svc (round-06/changes.md:4); CHG-147 benign. No 429s in r6. inventory-svc dns lookup failed kms.internal round-06/logs/inventory-svc.log:3,8,11,19,26,31,33,34,39,59,75,81 (log format now JSON). Open follow-ups: POSTMORTEM_DRAFT, CAPACITY_REVIEW. Round 6 done; next: advance.

Round7: board Thread B cause revised to DNS_RESOLUTION inventory-svc (round-07/board.md:3). Thread D opened MEMORY_LEAK pricing-svc ongoing (round-07/board.md:4) - verify in logs later (no memory errors in r7 ERROR grep; check WARN/restart lines). CHG-153 PROPOSED (ignore). dns kms.internal SERVFAIL round-07/logs/inventory-svc.log:1,3,21,29,31,59,65. Round 7 done; next: advance.

Round8: board Thread A resolved (round-08/board.md:3); follow-up OPEN DATA_BACKFILL (board.md:4). CHG-157 benign. No memory/restart lines in r8 for pricing-svc (MEMORY_LEAK thread D unverified, maybe false alarm). dns kms.internal round-08/logs/inventory-svc.log:6,21,22,27,49,59,60,62,72. Round 8 done; next: advance.

Round9: board Thread D (MEMORY_LEAK pricing-svc) closed false alarm (round-09/board.md:3). No changes.md. DNS_RESOLUTION kms.internal now also shipping-svc: round-09/logs/shipping-svc.log:17,38,57,58,66,78; inventory-svc.log:7,13,22,44,66,75,80. Round 9 done; next: advance.
Round 10 released (files round-10/board.md, changes.md, logs). Not yet analysed.
